text:
Lena: Quick runway check  we need a compact copy pass for the three mode landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private (VPC & on-prem)). Must include: single-line hero, one-line metric, webinar CTA, and simple webhook spec for registrants. 2pm sync to approve.
Omar: Ill be there. I have a short benchmark blurb we can use and can advise CTA phrasing for conversion.
Jules: I'll draft 2 hero options per mode and a microline for each. Posting drafts now. Keep tone product-focused, developer-forward.
Harper: Legal note: avoid the phrase "private cloud". Use "Private (VPC & on-prem)" and phrase key management as "customer-managed keys (CMK)". Replace "audit logs" with "audit trail".
OpsBot: Calendar invite created: https://calendar.example/event/4981239999. Reminder 30m.
Lena: Thanks — include one short stat under each hero (latency or tokens/min); Omar will confirm exact strings.
Jules: Draft heroes + microlines: 

Hosted H1: "Hosted API  ship LLM features without infra ops"
Micro: "p95 ~130ms (chat, 8k)  streaming responses & usage insights"
Hosted H2: "API-first inference, ready for production"
Micro: "Low-latency text, chat, and embeddings"

Dedicated D1: "Redwood Dedicated  reserved GPU pools for consistent throughput"
Micro: "Sustained throughput for customer-facing apps"
Dedicated D2: "Committed capacity, SLA-backed performance"
Micro: "Pin model versions and autoscale safely"

Private P1: "Private (VPC & on-prem)  run our runtime inside your perimeter"
Micro: "CMK, audit trail, and on-prem deployment options"
Private P2: "Bring inference into your network"
Micro: "Data control, integrations, and enterprise SLAs"

Jules: CTA options for the hero: "Save my seat  live benchmark + Q&A" / "See the launch demo: perf, rollout, and controls" / "Join demo: production inference patterns"
Omar: Prefer the first two. Add microline under CTA: "Includes benchmark walkthrough + 15-min office hours"  sets expectations.
Harper: Also avoid saying "pricing" on the hero. Use "cost controls" or "unit economics" if needed elsewhere.
Lena: Routing rules for webinar leads: bucket by employee_count -> {>=1500: enterprise-sales, 300-1499: AE/SDR, <300: growth-marketing}. Always include deployment_interest tag (hosted/dedicated/private). If deployment_interest=="Private" and employee_count>=500 -> escalate to enterprise-sales.
Jules: Can you paste a sample webhook payload so forms/dev can wire it?
Omar: sample payload (for wiring):

{
  "email": "participant@example.com",
  "name": "Sam Example",
  "company": "Example Co",
  "employee_count": 1200,
  "deployment_interest": "Dedicated",
  "utm_campaign": "launch-jun-2026"
}

Omar: Also include a field interests[] if they check multiple, e.g., ["Hosted","Dedicated"].
Lena: Nice. Action items: Jules pick Hosted H1, Dedicated D2, Private P1 as the default hero set and finalize microlines; Omar confirm canonical bench strings and post bench doc links; Harper confirm legal phrasing for CMK/audit trail; DevOps/forms to wire webhook with fields above and tag leads by deployment_interest and size_bucket. 2pm sync confirmers: @Omar @Jules @Harper.
Jules: Will post final copy and a quick hero mock for design by 1:15.
Omar: Ill attach bench doc and short perf blurb by 12:45.
Harper: Ill approve the CMK/audit trail language now.
OpsBot: Form created: https://forms.example/launch-jun-2026  mapped fields: email, name, company, employee_count, deployment_interest, utm_campaign. Webhook endpoint drafted.
Lena: If we lock heroes + CTA today we can stage the pages and enable the registration CTA. Thanks team. :rocket:
Jules: Posting mock in design channel in 20m.
Omar: See you at the sync.
Harper: Approved ✅
Lena: Great. End.
